expertise: validation safety boundaries and professional semantic precision

semantic_votes.rationale: Every candidate check must receive a task-local effect classification before authority can be evaluated; allowing an unclassified candidate to bypass this step would make unsafe execution appear eligible.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Applies only after targeted-validation-selection is selected and only to candidate checks within the active Task Contract; incomplete effects are classified unknown.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Use unknown when effects cannot be derived, then mark unsupported or unauthorized checks planned, blocked, or unrun; do not execute them.

semantic_votes.rationale: The detector mistakes categorical multiplicity for a fixed threshold. The sentence permits a command to carry several known effect labels and the following rule keeps unknown separate; no duration or status cutoff is imposed.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The phrase one or more describes simultaneous membership in the closed known-effect taxonomy; it is not a duration, pass threshold, or status rule.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the effect taxonomy and its separate unknown state; no source rewrite or time-bounded exception is needed.

semantic_votes.rationale: The conjunction is a fail-closed safety boundary, not an unconditional mechanism prescription: review can execute only supported read-only tools and only when the candidate is classified non-modifying.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Applies only to review-agent execution; the Profile exposes execute-read-only and explicitly requires non-modifying commands, so both capability and effect classification are mandatory.
semantic_votes.mitigation: If either tool support or non-modifying classification is missing, stop before execution and return the check as planned, blocked, or unrun.

limitations: Static source review establishes semantic fit against the current Root, checklist, Profile, and registry only; it does not prove host enforcement or actual command behavior.
No command under review was executed, and no production, external, destructive, privileged, or irreversible effect was exercised.
